About Us /

Empowering Maker & Tech Partnerships

At Merchant Media, we bridge the gap between the machining, DIY, and tech creator community and the brands that serve it. We specialize in authentic partnerships that drive engagement, brand awareness, and measurable ROI. Audiences who build, make, and machine put their trust in creators who do the same, and that trust is what we help brands earn.

From strategy development to execution, our hands-on team handles the hustle: deal negotiation, campaign management, brand matching. It's all taken care of, so creators can stay in the shop and brands can reach the audiences that matter.

For Creators /

Questions, Answered.

We're a boutique influencer marketing agency focused exclusively on the Tech, DIY, and Machining space. We connect creators in this niche with brands that want to reach audiences who actually build, make, and machine.

Your application goes straight to our team for review, and you're added to the Merchant Media waitlist. You become part of our broader creator network; when a brand campaign matches your niche, audience, and style, we reach out with the opportunity. No spam, no filler.

There's no hard minimum. We care more about engagement, content quality, and how well your audience fits the machining, DIY, and tech niche. A highly engaged 8K workshop channel can beat a passive 100K account every time.

No. Being on our waitlist and in our network is not exclusive, and it doesn't restrict deals you find on your own. Specific terms only apply per campaign, and you'll see and approve those before anything goes live.

Payment terms are set per campaign and agreed upfront before you create anything. We handle the negotiation, invoicing, and follow-up with the brand, so you get paid what was agreed, when it was agreed.

Email Policy

Last updated October 29, 2026.

MerchantMedia is an influencer marketing agency. This policy covers every email sent by MerchantMedia or on our behalf, from merchantmedia.co, merchantmedia.net, merchantmedia.org, and any subdomain of those domains.

What we never do.

  • Send bulk advertising, newsletters, or promotions to people who have not asked for them.
  • Buy, rent, or share email lists.
  • Allow any affiliate, partner, or third party to promote MerchantMedia by unsolicited email.

How we contact people we have not worked with before. Our work is one-to-one business introductions about a specific sponsorship or partnership.

  • We only write to business contact addresses, either an address published for inquiries or the work address of the person whose role the introduction concerns.
  • Each message is individually prepared for its recipient and sent by a named member of our team.
  • Our emails contain no tracking pixels and no tracked links.
  • Every marketing email includes a one-click unsubscribe link.

Stopping contact. A reply asking us to stop, in any wording, or clicking unsubscribe, ends contact from every MerchantMedia address. We add the address to a permanent suppression list and do not write to it again.

Reporting a problem. If you received an email you believe breaks this policy, forward it to mohammed@merchantmedia.co. We will stop all contact and look into how it happened.
